name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Dipolog City Leg
short_description: A half-marathon event of the National MILO Marathon series taking place in Dipolog City, Philippines on August 16, 2026.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Dipolog City Leg is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 16, 2026, in Dipolog City, Zamboanga del Norte, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc., the race is part of the long-running MILO Marathon series and offers multiple distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km. Registration status for this leg has not yet been confirmed as open.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km) suit a range of runner abilities

research_highlights: The Dipolog City leg offers four distance categories: 3K, 5K, 10K, and 21K.
This 2026 edition falls within the MILO Marathon's 50th anniversary 'Golden Run' series, which spans 15 city legs nationwide before the National Finals in Clark City, Pampanga.
Dipolog City has hosted MILO Marathon qualifying legs before — the city first joined the series' Western Mindanao expansion back in 2006 during the marathon's 30th anniversary season.

The race is organized by RUNRIO Inc. in partnership with Nestlé Philippines, the Department of Education, Philippine Sports Commission, and Philippine Olympic Committee, with roughly 70% of the expected 300,000 nationwide participants being students.

faqs.question: When is the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Dipolog City Leg?
faqs.answer: This event is scheduled to take place on August 16, 2026. It will be held in Dipolog City, located in Zamboanga del Norte province, Philippines. No additional scheduling details, such as start times for specific distance categories, have been confirmed yet.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The race offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km run, a 5km run, and a 3km run. The 21.1km half-marathon is considered the primary distance for this particular leg of the MILO Marathon series.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: This race is organized by RUNRIO Inc., which runs the broader National MILO Marathon series across various cities in the Philippines. The Dipolog City Leg is one part of this larger nationwide series of races held under the MILO Marathon banner.
